    Questions this page answers

    Where does my score go?

    Nowhere outside your browser. Your ticks are saved in this browser's local storage so they survive a reload; nothing is sent to NextGenergy or anyone else. Use Reset to clear them. They do not sync across devices. Export CSV saves a file to your own computer only.

    What counts as a record?

    Something you could hand to an auditor today: a test sheet with a date, a technician and a result, a factory certificate indexed to a serial number, a connection log entry. A verbal assurance or a line in a schedule saying the test was planned does not count. The turnover package, boundary by boundary →
